title: Salesforce pages loading slowly for Chicago office users
summary: Page loads of 20-60 seconds for users on the Chicago office network. Users elsewhere are not affected. Network team suspects the office web proxy change CHG-4420.
workaround: Use the Salesforce mobile app, or connect to the 'US-Direct' GlobalProtect gateway, which bypasses the Chicago office proxy.

title: Floor 3 printers offline in the London office
summary: The print server for London floor 3 is down after a failed patch. Engineers are restoring it.
workaround: Release print jobs at any floor 2 or floor 4 printer with your badge (PaperCut Follow-Me printing).

title: Delayed external email delivery
summary: External email was delayed by up to 2 hours. Resolved by Microsoft.
